title: Existing-state conditioner map for internal gradient correction
question: Does lower-boundary disequilibrium already encoded by the B9 terminal slope condition the sign and relative amplitude of the Reference-required internal-gradient correction better than geometry-only slope contrast?

response.name: delta_ref
response.s_ref: 1-qi_ref/Kref_bar using B8 qi_ref and arithmetic mean Reference endpoint interface K
response.s_base: 1-qi_B9/Ki_bar using B9 interval qi and arithmetic mean B9 endpoint Ki
response.role: diagnostic response only; never used to define or scale predictors

P_BOUNDARY.interpretation: B9 lower-boundary hydraulic disequilibrium; proportional to B9 qH/Ks

P_INTERACTION.interpretation: response-blind interaction of internal slope contrast with lower-boundary disequilibrium

diagnostics.per_width_pooled_moving: Pool WT_RISE and WT_FALL only. For each predictor report signed cosine with delta_ref, Pearson correlation, same-sign fraction on intervals where |delta_ref| and |predictor| exceed the numerical floor, and predictor-vs-response RMS after no scaling.
diagnostics.per_history: Report the same diagnostics separately for WT_RISE and WT_FALL.
diagnostics.hold_guard: For WT_HOLD report predictor RMS and max_abs. No sign score is interpreted because delta_ref is numerically near zero.
diagnostics.state_context: Report ranges of H, theta_b and theta_t by history to bind the conditioner map to the existing Wb/Wt/H state regions already implicated by C4K.

numerical_floor.role: numerical sign/cosine guard only; not hydrological acceptance

decision_rule.FACE_BOUNDARY_INTERACTION_SIGNAL_SUPPORT: At both widths in pooled moving data, P_INTERACTION has strictly larger signed cosine and same-sign fraction than both P_FACE and P_BOUNDARY; and in HOLD its RMS is strictly smaller than P_FACE.
decision_rule.FACE_GEOMETRY_SIGNAL_REMAINS_STRONGER: At both widths P_FACE has signed cosine and same-sign fraction at least as large as both alternatives.
decision_rule.BOUNDARY_SIGNAL_REMAINS_STRONGER: At both widths P_BOUNDARY has signed cosine and same-sign fraction at least as large as both alternatives.
decision_rule.NO_SINGLE_EXISTING_STATE_CONDITIONER_DOM: Hard gates pass but no predictor satisfies one of the uniform dominance rules.

interpretation_boundary: C4O is a mechanism map, not a closure qualification.
A supported interaction signal would only authorize preregistration of a parameter-free interaction candidate; it would not authorize propagation.
A non-dominant result sends the workstream back to representation selection rather than post-hoc tuning.
No application acceptance, groundwater feedback or speed claim is adjudicated.
